source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: At the start of a battle round, a triple 6 on your [Blessings of Khorne](vsdata:ability/world-eaters.blessings-of-khorne) roll can bring back a destroyed Angron in place of a Blessing. When Reinforcements arrive in your next [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), restore him to the battlefield via [Deep Strike](vsdata:core-ability/deep-strike) with 8 wounds left.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.

prerequisites: triple 6 on Blessings of Khorne roll

return.timing: Reinforcements step of next own Movement phase
